metadata.title: Kikiria
metadata.description: A game to look, ask and check what you find online.

home.mascotAlt: Roqui, a little detective rooster holding a magnifying glass.
home.title: Can you tell which photo was made by AI?

tutorial.introTitle: Find the image made with AI
tutorial.introLead: You will see two images: one is a photo and the other was made by a computer.
tutorial.introHint: Getting it wrong is fine: that is how we learn.
tutorial.question: Which one was made with AI?
tutorial.selectedHint: You can change your choice before checking.
tutorial.modelAria: Thinking steps: Look, Ask and Check

media.round1LeftAlt: Temporary illustration of a garden poster with a sign.
media.round1RightAlt: Temporary illustration of a poster with colourful shapes and unusual letter-like marks.
media.round2LeftAlt: Temporary illustration of a library with books, a lamp and a plant.
media.round2RightAlt: Temporary illustration of a night festival with lights and stalls.
media.round3LeftAlt: Temporary illustration of a night market with lanterns and stalls.
media.round3RightAlt: Temporary illustration of a daytime market with a stall and colourful fruit shapes.

round1.observation: Some letters do not form words.
round1.remember: It is a clue, not proof.

round2.question: Who published this image, and why?
round2.remember: Appearance does not tell the whole story.

round3.verification: Find the source and review the context.
round3.remember: We cannot always know just by looking.

worlds.title: Choose your mission!
worlds.description: Every mission helps you pause and think before you believe or share.

training.description: Practise looking closely and asking helpful questions.

source.title: Check the Source

context.title: Missing Context
context.description: Look for information that could change a story.
